```{r}
source("Scripts/packages.R")

dados = readxl::read_excel("Bancos/dados_completos.xlsx")

#Se deseja usar os poligonos nos mapas
source("Scripts/load_poligonos.R")
```

```{r}
##HEATMAP

dados_graph = dados %>% na.omit() %>% filter(MEDALHA == "Ouro") %>% group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% na.omit()

leaflet(dados_graph) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addHeatmap(
    ~LATITUDE, ~LONGITUDE, 
    intensity = ~sqrt(count),
    blur = 10, max = ~max(sqrt(count))
  ) -> mapa_gradient

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(mapa_gradient, "Mapas/gradient.html")
```
